about_the_game:
◆ Game Overview

In this story-rich RPG, you play as a young martial artist who, by chance, finds himself enrolled in the prestigious Mingjing Academy — a school famed for cultivating future legends of the martial world.

But this is more than just a place of study.
It’s a crossroads of rival powers, tangled politics, and secrets from the past.

Court intrigue, factional strife, remnants of a fallen cult...
In this world of shifting alliances, the line between good and evil is never clear.

Through quiet days and turbulent events, you'll meet colorful characters, uncover hidden truths, and carve your own path in a living, breathing wuxia world.

With immersive storytelling, rich character interactions, open-ended development, and a unique combat technique system, step into a sprawling martial epic like no other.

◆ Key Features

◎ A Massive Story to Uncover

Over 500,000 words of original narrative and 30+ hand-drawn CGs.
Tons of side quests and bonus content deepen your journey through the martial world.

Multiple endings await — will you become the “Master Healer,” the “Wanderer,” the “Jack-of-All-Trades,” or unite the land under your banner?

◎ Build Your Character, Your Way

Train your martial skills on the field, study ancient texts in class, and rise to the top.

With 12 development paths, live a balanced academic life of both mind and body, and shape your own martial identity.

Grow herbs, cook meals, grill over an open fire, go hunting, play strategy games, take on bounty quests — the choice is yours.

◎Turn-Based Combat

Classic turn-based battles enhanced with a unique Technique Stage and Technique Branching system.

Mix and match over 100 martial arts techniques and inner styles to create your own signature fighting style.

Master timing, adapt to the flow of battle, and unleash devastating combos in one fluid strike.

◎ Forge Bonds in the Martial World

Meet 8 distinct characters, each with their own backgrounds, personalities, and stories — including 3 romance options and 2 potential party members.

From busy market streets to quiet teahouses, your relationships will grow through shared encounters and heartfelt conversations.

Raise your bond with each character to unlock unique storylines, exclusive CGs, and meaningful choices that shape your journey.

◆ Character Profiles

A native of Kaifeng, raised in a decent household (with branching options during character creation).
Calm, responsible, and quietly drawn to the world of martial heroes.
Not born to be a legend — but determined to walk the path.

A cheerful girl from the Miao tribe of Yunling.

Known for her mountain songs and riddles, she commands twin snakes with the bells she wears, and is skilled in poison and medicine.

She leaves her village in search of the truth behind a certain event. After solving a poisoning case, she’s discovered by the academy and granted the chance to take the entrance exam.

Owner of the Fan Pavilion, warm and wise, always seen with her round fan.
As the eldest daughter of the Wenren family, she’s managed the family business since youth.
Her eyes light up when she sees account books. In her free time, she enjoys reading storybooks and trying her hand at cooking.

Daughter of the Xuan Dao Sect leader. Wields ring blades with grace.
Gentle in appearance but strong-willed and fiercely loyal.
Raised to uphold the image of a sect leader’s daughter, she maintains elegance and composure — though she secretly longs to explore the world beyond.

Hailing from the royal court, already trusted to carry out missions outside the palace at a young age.
Efficient, quiet, and emotionally reserved — but never lacking in ability.

Daughter of a local magistrate from a scholarly family.
Strong-willed and sharp-eyed, with a passion for law since childhood.
She’s devoured every legal text in her home library.

A young disciple of the Lantern Shadow Pavilion.
Skilled beyond his years, but blunt and outspoken — often leading to minor “misunderstandings.”

A bright, witty disciple of Xiangguo Temple.
Polite and always smiling, with a silver tongue that persuades even the most frugal to offer incense.
He serves as the temple’s charming public face.

Martial arts instructor at Mingjing Academy.

Calm and disciplined, with the air of a seasoned veteran.

Though strict in training, he’s known for his bold spirit and generosity — and is beloved by generations of students.

name: Tales of Justice Academy: Winds Arise

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS Windows10 64 bit
  • Processor: intel i3-3220 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT730 or equivalent Intel/AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS Windows10 64 bit
  • Processor: intel i5-7600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: You can play as a young martial artist entering Justice Academy. Train through various courses, customize your build with different weapons, skills, and inner techniques. Explore the jianghu, bond with companions, and shape your fate across branching stories and three romanceable heroines.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
